europe_now.title: Russian Strikes Hit Kyiv Infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Russian attacks hit a major bridge and logistics hub in Kyiv, marking the second major bridge targeted across the Dnipro river. The strikes have deepened travel chaos and transportation disruptions within Ukraine's capital.

europe_now.title: Housing Crisis Protests Erupt Across Spain
europe_now.summary: Tens of thousands of demonstrators protested across Spain demanding government action following a legislative rejection of housing relief measures. The widespread public discontent and ensuing political pressure have led to speculation regarding potential snap elections.

top_stories.title: Latvian Parliamentary Election
top_stories.summary: Exit polls indicate that the prime minister's pro-Ukraine party has taken the lead in Latvia's general election. Meanwhile, several coalition partners experienced notable setbacks during the voting process.

top_stories.title: Security Threat Charges in the United Kingdom
top_stories.summary: British authorities have remanded two Iranian nationals following formal charges regarding an alleged bomb plot targeting the Jewish community. Additional security concerns emerged as a separate suspect was charged with planning a terror act against Nigel Farage.
